operational_record.cause_of_end: Arrival of polar winter night cut off solar array insolation; lander structure subsequently crushed by winter carbon dioxide dry ice accumulation
operational_record.historic_feat: First direct excavation, physical touching, and chemical confirmation of shallow water-ice layers beneath the Martian soil

science_instruments: Robotic Arm (RA) with ice-scraping rasp drill and thermal/electrical conductivity probe
Microscopy, Electrochemistry, and Conductivity Analyzer (MECA - Wet Chemistry Laboratory)
Meteorological Station (MET) with Canadian lidar laser atmospheric sounding

historic_discoveries.details: Robotic arm scraped 5cm into soil in the 'Dodo-Goldilocks' trench exposing bright white material; over 4 sols, chunks of the white material sublimated directly into vapor, conclusively proving they were water ice and not salt
historic_discoveries.significance: Confirmed massive northern circumpolar permafrost ice table at depth of just 5 centimeters

historic_discoveries.details: MECA wet chemistry laboratory measured 0.5% to 1.0% magnesium and calcium perchlorate in arctic soil. Perchlorates act as an anti-freeze depressing the freezing point of water to -70°C, creating transient liquid brines
historic_discoveries.significance: CRITICAL ASTRONAUT HEALTH HAZARD: Potent human endocrine/thyroid disruptor, combustible when dry, requires rigorous suit decon

historic_discoveries.details: Lidar detected water-ice snow precipitation falling from cirrus clouds at 4 km altitude, sublimating before reaching the surface (virga)
historic_discoveries.significance: Active modern Martian hydrological cycle verified

astronaut_tactical_note: Extreme northern location provides unlimited water ice beneath 5cm of topsoil. However, perchlorate toxicity is severe: EVA suit washdown airlocks with chemical neutralizers are mandatory to prevent habitant lung and thyroid poisoning.
